annotation.title_clean: Establishing the Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027 ***I — Amendments adopted by the European Parliament on 13 December 2018
annotation.title_en: Establishing the Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027 ***I — Amendments adopted by the European Parliament on 13 December 2018
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 388
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament first-reading amendments to the Commission's proposed Digital Europe programme regulation for 2021-2027, covering HPC, AI, cybersecurity, digital skills and deployment. Adds ethical review for AI actions, GDPR compliance, a EUR 9.2bn budget and a clause bringing AI-powered robotics within the AI objective.
key_provisions_or_claims: Programme funding of EUR 9.194bn (current prices) across five specific objectives including AI (EUR 2.5bn)
Amendment 31: AI objectives should encompass robotics powered by AI
Amendment 84: ethical review of every AI project; ethically unacceptable actions ineligible for funding
Amendment 80: AI solutions must respect privacy and security by design, with humans at the centre
Restrictions on third-country participation for strategic and security reasons; no technology transfer outside the Union
